messages:
Maria (Sales): FYI we have a migration POC request from SwitchR. They want to retire CompetitorX and validate a compatibility layer + functional parity. @Jonah you up for SE lead?
Jonah (SE): Happy to. Need quick answers: which CompetitorX model family are they using, do they use streaming or function-calls extensively, any custom tokenizers or truncation heuristics? Also ask for a canonical eval set.
Priya (SwitchR): Were using compx-large, yes to streaming and function-calls (they use a webhook with name+args). Our hot path is short prompts (<=200 tokens) but we have a few long-context flows (~8k). Well share ~600 prompts + expected outputs; biggest pain is payload shape for function calls and different math rounding.
Devin (AE): Pricing note: they care about short-term POC cost and a migration price model (committed vs usage). Ill draft a POC price and a two-tier migration offer: migration credits + commit discount.
Jonah (SE): POC outline proposal:
- Day 0: kickoff + ingest artifacts (prompts, expected outputs, logs)
- Days 1-3: thin compat shim + mapping tests (param names, streaming frames)
- Days 4-8: automated parity runs (A/B vs compx) + fix shim heuristics
- Days 9-14: load tests, latency SLAs, security checklist, customer validation
Suggested pass conditions: >92% token-level overlap on canonical responses OR >=0.85 embedding cosine vs gold; function-call schema match >=98% on name+args; p50 latency <= competitor +30ms.
Priya (SwitchR): We can provide logs showing typical RPS and an extract of webhook payloads. Function-call differences: competitor returns args flattened, they expect nested JSON.
Jonah (SE): Example mapping snippet for dev team:
```
# CompetitorX request
POST /v1/generate
{ "prompt": "Extract entities", "max_tokens": 120, "stream": true }
# Redwood request
POST /v1/responses
{ "input": "Extract entities", "max_output_tokens": 120, "stream": true }
# shim: rename prompt->input, max_tokens->max_output_tokens, translate streaming chunks to Redwood frames
```
Also will add a small post-processor to reformat function-call args to the nested shape they expect.
Liz - Security: Share SwitchRs security questionnaire and Ill pre-complete SOC2 items, data residency notes, and KMS/HSM support. For the POC we can offer hosted with VPC peering and ephemeral keys.
Devin (AE): For the cost estimate: if they run ~30k tokens/day in POC (14 days) that's ~420k tokens. Hosted cost ~ $720 at list rate; we can offer a migration credit of 50% for the POC and a 3-month commit discount for migration. Drafting numbers now.
deploy-bot: preview/compat-shim deployed to preview.switchr.redwood 50ms avg latency, health OK
Maria (Sales): Thanks team. Ill send a short SOW + meeting invite for Tue 9am PT with SwitchR infra + security. Jonah, please attach the eval harness repo link in the invite.
Jonah (SE): Will do. Ill include scripts to compute token-level overlap, BLEU-ish similarity, and a simple hallucination check (answer contains unsupported facts).
Priya (SwitchR): Great — appreciate the clear plan. Expect artifacts in this thread by EOD. :thumbsup:
Devin (AE): Will follow up with formal quote and short-term dedicated burst options for the migration window.
Liz - Security: Once questionnaire is in Ill flag any blockers (onshore hosting, logging retention) within 24h.
Maria (Sales): Keeping this thread as the canonical POC coordination channel.
